SELECT id, title, author, quote_extract_retry_count
FROM books
WHERE aladin_status = 'validated'
  AND quote_extract_status = FALSE
  AND quote_extract_next_retry_at <= NOW()
ORDER BY quote_extract_next_retry_at, id
LIMIT 100;

UPDATE books
SET quote_extract_status = TRUE,
    quote_extract_retry_count = 0,
    quote_extract_next_retry_at = NOW(),
    quote_extract_error_reason = NULL,
    quote_extracted_at = '{{ $('응답 파싱').first().json.quote_extracted_at }}'::timestamp
WHERE id = {{ $('응답 파싱').first().json.id }};
